verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS security scanner, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only a GitHub App, a dashboard, a v1 REST API, webhooks and an MCP server for AI tools, with no official command-line tool. The API, OpenAPI spec and MCP server are adjacent building blocks and do not count as a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
